news.title: Commercial Bank Sees Improvement in Asset Quality With Lower NPL Ratios
news.summary: Commercial Bank reports improved asset quality and capital strength.
news.content: Commercial Bank of Ceylon PLC highlighted improved loan recoveries and a reduction in non-performing loans. The bank stated that stronger capital buffers and prudent risk management supported balance sheet stability.

news.title: Sampath Bank Expands Digital Banking Services to Drive Retail Growth
news.summary: Sampath Bank enhances digital platforms to support customer growth.
news.content: Sampath Bank PLC announced enhancements to its digital banking platforms aimed at increasing customer engagement and transaction volumes. Management stated that digital adoption continues to support operating efficiency.

news.title: Dialog Axiata Records Steady Data Revenue Growth
news.summary: Dialog benefits from higher mobile broadband usage.
news.content: Dialog Axiata PLC reported steady growth in data revenues driven by higher smartphone penetration and increased mobile broadband consumption. The company noted sustained demand for digital connectivity services.

news.title: Sri Lanka Telecom Benefits From Rising Enterprise Connectivity Demand
news.summary: SLT sees increased demand for fiber and enterprise solutions.
news.content: Sri Lanka Telecom PLC stated that demand for enterprise connectivity and fiber services increased, particularly from corporate and government clients. The company expects enterprise solutions to remain a key revenue driver.

news.title: Cargills Maintains Stable Margins Despite Input Cost Pressures
news.summary: Cargills offsets higher costs through supply-chain efficiencies.
news.content: Cargills (Ceylon) PLC reported stable margins despite higher logistics and raw material costs. The company cited improved supply-chain efficiencies and pricing discipline as key mitigating factors.

news.title: Watawala Plantations Earnings Decline Due to Weak Tea Output
news.summary: Lower production offsets stable auction prices.
news.content: Watawala Plantations PLC reported a decline in quarterly earnings as adverse weather conditions impacted tea production volumes. Despite relatively stable auction prices, reduced output and higher input costs negatively affected overall profitability.

news.title: Dialog Axiata Reports Slower Revenue Growth Amid Competitive Pressure
news.summary: Intense competition weighs on topline expansion.
news.content: Dialog Axiata PLC posted slower revenue growth for the quarter as intense competition in mobile and broadband services led to pricing pressure. The company noted that promotional spending increased while average revenue per user remained subdued.

news.title: Aitken Spence Hotels Benefit From Rising Tourist Arrivals
news.summary: Peak season bookings support hotel sector earnings.
news.content: Aitken Spence Hotel Holdings PLC reported stronger bookings during the peak tourist season, particularly from European and Asian markets. The company expects seasonal demand to support earnings.

news.title: Distilleries Company Reports Stable Volumes Despite Higher Excise Costs
news.summary: Stable demand offsets regulatory cost pressures.
news.content: Distilleries Company of Sri Lanka PLC reported stable sales volumes supported by steady domestic demand. Higher excise-related costs, however, continued to weigh on margins.

news.title: Lion Brewery Faces Margin Pressure From Rising Production Costs
news.summary: Input cost inflation impacts brewery profitability.
news.content: Lion Brewery (Ceylon) PLC stated that rising raw material and energy costs affected profitability. While sales volumes remained stable, margin pressures persisted.

news.title: Watawala Plantations Benefits From Improved Tea Auction Prices
news.summary: Higher tea prices support plantation sector revenues.
news.content: Watawala Plantations PLC reported revenue growth supported by higher average tea prices at Colombo auctions. Improved pricing trends partially offset higher wage and input costs.

news.title: Lanka IOC Maintains Steady Operations Amid Fuel Price Stability
news.summary: Stable global oil prices support predictable margins.
news.content: Lanka IOC PLC reported steady fuel distribution volumes as global oil prices remained relatively stable. The company noted improved predictability in operating margins.

news.title: Vidullanka Expands Renewable Energy Portfolio With New Projects
news.summary: Renewable expansion aligns with national energy targets.
news.content: Vidullanka PLC announced progress in expanding its renewable energy portfolio through new mini-hydro projects. The company stated that expansion aligns with long-term sustainability goals.

news.title: Wymans Reports Improved Export Performance Across Key Segments
news.summary: Export demand supports diversified earnings growth.
news.content: Wymans PLC reported improved export performance driven by stronger demand in agricultural and industrial segments. Management cited favorable global market conditions.

news.title: Access Engineering Secures New Infrastructure Contracts
news.content: Access Engineering PLC announced the award of several public-sector infrastructure contracts. The company stated that the new projects strengthen its medium-term order book.

news.title: HNB Assurance Records Growth in Life Insurance Premiums
news.summary: Higher policy uptake supports insurance sector growth.
news.content: HNB Assurance PLC reported growth in life insurance premiums driven by increased policy uptake and improved customer retention. The company noted steady demand for protection products.

news.title: LOLC Holdings Reports Steady Performance Across Regional Operations
news.summary: Balanced contributions from domestic and overseas markets.
news.content: LOLC Holdings PLC reported stable performance across its regional operations, with balanced contributions from domestic and overseas markets. Management highlighted portfolio diversification.

news.title: Lanka Hospitals Sees Higher Patient Volumes in Specialized Care
news.summary: Specialized healthcare demand supports revenue growth.
news.content: Lanka Hospitals Corporation PLC reported increased patient volumes in specialized care units. The company cited rising demand for advanced medical services.

news.title: Vidullanka PLC Reports Lower Power Generation and Thus Lower Profits
news.summary: Reduced rainfall impacts energy output and earnings.
news.content: Vidullanka PLC reported a decline in power generation during the period, primarily due to adverse weather conditions and lower rainfall affecting several of its hydro power plants. The company stated that the reduced generation negatively impacted revenue and profitability, while ongoing cost pressures further weighed on financial performance.
